candidate_semantic_classification.assessment: distributed client and JournalNode writer-epoch guard
candidate_semantic_classification.basis: the request epoch is sent by the QJM writer while each JournalNode compares it with its persisted lastWriterEpoch; an injected write failure can legitimately leave the local value behind
candidate_semantic_classification.label: cross_node_writer_epoch_check

coverage_metric_note: JaCoCo probe IDs are exact; branch_counts uses per-method covered branch counts as a stable monotone feedback proxy, not individual branch IDs. Runtime-generated Mockito mock classes are excluded from all production coverage.
elapsed_seconds_semantics: sum of one healthy JUnit duration and independent fault-trial JUnit durations; excludes legacy GraphChecker trials, instrumentation build, and coverage postprocessing
source_review: Journal.checkWriteRequest at line 517 compares the request epoch with the JournalNode-local lastWriterEpoch. A failed last-writer-epoch file write leaves that node at epoch 0 while the client sends epoch 1; the resulting IOException is the intended guard response. Two independent smoke replays confirmed the exact 1-versus-0 transition; see README.md.
